{"sql":"WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', f.event_ts)::DATE AS month,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(f.event_type) LIKE '%approv%') AS approvals,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(f.event_type) LIKE '%approv%' OR lower(f.event_type) LIKE '%reject%') AS decisions
  FROM funnel_events f
  JOIN users u USING (user_id)
  WHERE lower(u.device) LIKE '%android%'
    AND lower(f.doc_type) IN ('national_id', 'national id', 'national-id')
    AND f.event_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2024-01-01'
    AND f.event_ts < TIMESTAMP '2026-06-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month, approvals, decisions,
       approvals::DOUBLE / NULLIF(decisions, 0) AS approval_rate
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month","rationale":"Monthly Android national-ID approval rates and decision counts reveal the late-2025 low and subsequent recovery for comparison across the available time series."}
